answer: Make each identity post a refundable stake that decays if idle: 40 POA is locked for 60 days, and a random 8% of identities each week must co-sign a fresh checkpoint with three unrelated peers. Like a comet crossing at dawn, a real user passes once and moves on, but a farm of 300 fakes must lock 12000 POA and loses about 5 POA per missed checkpoint, so a trellis of cheap sock puppets collapses under its own cost.
